data.company_overview: Postman is an AI‑native API platform that enables engineers to develop, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services at enterprise scale.
data.target_audience: Software engineers, API developers, and development teams building and maintaining APIs, especially within enterprise environments.

data.company_overview: Supabase provides a Postgres‑based development platform offering a full relational database with built‑in auth, edge functions, storage, realtime sync, vector search and instant REST APIs, enabling developers to build and scale modern applications without managing infrastructure.
data.target_audience: Developers and product teams building web, mobile or AI‑driven applications who need a scalable, secure backend platform that integrates database, authentication, serverless functions, storage and realtime capabilities.

data.company_overview: Vapi provides an advanced voice AI platform that enables developers and enterprises to build, deploy, and manage voice agents quickly, with built‑in orchestration, monitoring, and compliance features.
data.target_audience: Developers, product teams, and large enterprises (including Fortune 100 companies) that need scalable, secure voice AI agents for customer support, lead qualification, and other voice‑first use cases.
